name: RAP.COM
editorial_article: RAP.COM is a music entity associated with the compilation release of the same name, which appeared on the market in 2000. While the name shares linguistic roots with the broader digital evolution of hip-hop distribution at the turn of the millennium, it is primarily documented in archival databases as a specific collection of tracks. The compilation serves as a snapshot of the era's rap landscape, reflecting the transition of the genre into the digital age. Despite the proliferation of similarly named entities and digital radio platforms, this specific iteration remains defined by its 2000 CD release, which cataloged various artists and contributions significant to the commercial hip-hop scene at the time. It stands as a testament to the period when physical media compilations were still a primary vehicle for introducing audiences to a wide array of rap talent.
